description: The author argues that existing negligence and products liability doctrines can be adapted to address AI-related harms without requiring sweeping legal reform.

instances.assertion: The author argues that existing negligence and products liability doctrines can be adapted to address AI-related harms without requiring sweeping legal reform.
Negligence liability requires proof that a developer or user failed to act as a reasonable person would in developing or using an AI agent.
